instructions.meaning: 目的、最終判断、完了判断をAIへ無条件に委ねない原則を維持しつつ、対象業務で十分な能力が確認できた場合は、明示した範囲に限って一部を委譲できるIntentへ改める
instructions.text: intentで，「AIへ目的、最終判断、完了判断を丸ごと委ねない」としているが，AIに十分な能力があると判断できたら，一部を委譲する方針で，書いて．

session_evidence.retained_evidence: decision-scoped Human instruction, prior Intent revision record and updated artifact digests
session_evidence.retention_limitation: 会話全体の永続参照identityは取得できないため、委譲方針の変更指示、委譲条件、保持するHuman authority、成果物Digestを本recordへ保持する

delegable: bounded elaboration of purpose within the Human-approved product purpose and policy
acceptance or rejection decisions within an explicitly authorized class and scope
completion decisions within an explicitly authorized class and scope
preconditions: capability evidence specific to the target work
required evidence and stop or escalation conditions
traceable recording of the deciding actor, evidence and authority
retained_by_human: product reason for existence and policy
decision whether and how far to delegate
change, suspension and revocation of delegation
decisions outside delegation and irreversible high-impact decisions

implementation_scope.included: Intent policy and current Plan intent-reference digest alignment
implementation_scope.excluded: Requirements, detailed delegation mechanism design and implementation
implementation_scope.future_condition: Before implementing delegation, capability evaluation, scope enforcement, stop conditions and provenance recording must be defined in Requirements and Plan

verification.intent_reference_check: passed: consolidated Plan references the updated Intent digest
verification.policy_self_check: passed: delegation is evidence-based, bounded, time-limited, traceable, revocable and fail-closed outside scope
verification.source_digest_check: passed: all three Intent generation sources still match front-matter digests
